title: Mass file encryption and shadow copy deletion on file server
description: EDR observed simlock.exe renaming 14,211 files to the .simlock extension on SRV-FILE-02 over 96 seconds, immediately preceded by 'vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet' and the Windows Defender service entering a stopped state. A ransom note (READ_ME_RECOVERY.txt) was written to the Finance share. Initial access appears to trace back to workstation WKS-4417, where Outlook spawned an encoded PowerShell command earlier the same morning.

indicators.context: Hash of simlock.exe observed encrypting the Finance share
Outbound destination contacted by both WKS-4417 and SRV-FILE-02
Domain resolved prior to stage-2 payload download
